import sys

def find_idempotent_k(n, f):
    def is_idempotent(f):
        for i in range(n):
            if f[f[i] - 1] != f[i]:
                return False
        return True

    current_f = f[:]
    k = 1
    while not is_idempotent(current_f):
        next_f = [current_f[current_f[i] - 1] for i in range(n)]
        current_f = next_f
        k += 1
    return k

n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
f = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))
print(find_idempotent_k(n, f))
